Container.Name: Homestead
Container.Overview: Homestead is a self-hosted digital home for local movies, TV, music, books, archived YouTube, collections, watch orders, progress, and personal archives. This listing installs the free preview for one owner and one active stream.
Container.Description: Homestead organizes and plays your local media in one private, self-hosted interface. The free preview includes Movies, TV, Music, Books, locally archived YouTube, search, playback, watchlists, collections, watch orders, and progress. Keep the AppData path backed up before updating. Homestead does not provide media or grant rights to obtain, copy, or distribute content.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: personal media server movies tv music books youtube self-hosted
